name: vm-archive
question: Archive the Refute VM's records (C:/ProgramData/RefuteVm, C:/ProgramData/RefuteVm-backup, and .cache/vm except ssh/ and gnupg/) to a new folder of the maintainer's Drive, with a SHA-256 manifest of source and copy, checked (block W, item W1(g)1, #218 comment 7229841832). choices: docs/validation/v0.5.13/tools/vm_archive.py --dest-name <new folder> --record <project folder>. It copies and checks; it never deletes or moves. Writes outside the phase's disk roots (the Drive folder; a declared limit). Offline. It emits no case value.
